findings.defect: “Ah” reads as an exclamation, not the audible ending of the name the father has spoken.
findings.rationale: The Korean leaves only the intimate vocative ending visible while withholding the name until the later reveal.

findings.defect: Changes Taekyung’s perception of heat into a visual judgment, weakening his next line about being able to feel it.
findings.rationale: He uses the heat he can feel as evidence that he has come to his senses.

findings.current: A young child, who could whine like that without finding it the least bit strange.
findings.defect: Makes the child, rather than the observing narrator, the one who finds the whining unsurprising.
findings.rationale: The line describes how natural the child’s whining feels to Taekyung as he experiences the memory.
findings.replacement: A child so young that hearing myself whine didn’t feel strange at all.
findings.source: 칭얼거리는 것이 조금도 어색하게 느껴지지 않을 정도의 어린아이.

findings.current: A father’s voice speaking to his son. His name.
findings.defect: “His name” can refer to the father, obscuring that Taekyung heard the son’s name.
findings.rationale: The name revealed later is the name the father spoke to his son.
findings.replacement: A father’s voice speaking to his son. His son’s name.
findings.source: 아들을 향한 아버지의 음성을. 그 이름을.

findings.defect: Drops the speaker’s clipped first attempt at the address.
findings.rationale: 장님 is the end of 조장님; the repeated address conveys the speaker’s alarm.

findings.current: the Extreme Yang energy that flowed through me.
findings.rationale: The source identifies the flowing 기운 as Extreme Yang; the binding terminology specifies qi for Murim 기운.
findings.replacement: the Extreme Yang qi flowing through me.

summary: The draft preserves the scene, but several cues are mistranslated or lost.
